conversation_groups.name: Merchant follow-up and investment
conversation_groups.flow: Existing visit -> investment offer for share/no-share -> amount choice -> thanks, zero-amount browsing response or insufficient-funds refusal. These are alternatives, not one consecutive speech.

conversation_groups.name: Trade capacity and funds warnings
conversation_groups.flow: Purchase selection -> capacity or funds objection; native purchase function controls the return.

conversation_groups.name: Extra-stock adviser alternatives
conversation_groups.flow: Current extra-stock predicate -> one of seven role3 adviser voices; not seven consecutive speakers.

conversation_groups.name: Contract refusal
conversation_groups.flow: Merchant visit -> missing contract -> facility-specific request to sign and return.

conversation_groups.name: Paid market viewing refusal
conversation_groups.flow: Quoted viewing price -> insufficient funds -> merchant refusal.
